narrative_summary: ALAB surged 13.14% on May 19 after AI connectivity demand commentary. RBC reiterated Outperform and raised PT $225 -> $250. Evercore ISI maintained Outperform with substantial PT increase. Amazon-Anthropic deal cited as funneling demand to ALAB; RBC expects Scorpio X switches to ramp in Trainium3 racks in Q3. ALAB participating in J.P. Morgan 2026 Global TMT Conference. Q1 2026 earnings/revenue beat with optimistic Q2 outlook driven by AI fabric and signal conditioning portfolios.
